description: Exploratory positive rank-one diagonal corrections within the accepted-step row space; four measured fits per variant after two warmups. The held-out unbalanced weighted case failed the objective gate; no production changes. In-run source/binary hashes and every measured fit are in the result JSON. Source-only archive; extension binary omitted.
reproduction: Extract explore.py into bench/projected_metric in a matching source checkout and run PYTHONPATH=. python3 bench/projected_metric/explore.py on Apple silicon MLX 0.32.x.
